en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear, sounds like an urban merchant song (cloth seller). 'Маршин' seems a rhyming nonsense echo of 'аршин'. The '(Друга верзија)' marker line is copied unchanged.
